title: knautia drymeja subsp. intermedia

It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
